codex.paladinBody: Only {count} of the {total} AoE2:DE civilizations can research {name}, making it one of the rarest Imperial upgrades in the game.
codex.camelBody: Only {count} of the {total} civilizations have access to {name}, the most mobile answer to shut down heavy cavalry compositions.
codex.onagerBody: Out of all {total} civilizations, just {count} unlock {name} in Imperial Age — decisive on closed maps and late-game stalemates.
codex.bbcBody: {count} of the {total} civilizations field {name}, the key answer to snipe enemy Onagers, Scorpions, and Castles from afar.
codex.redemptionBody: {count} of the {total} civilizations can research {name} to convert enemy Mangonels and buildings right in Castle Age.
codex.thumbringBody: {count} of the {total} civilizations get {name}, boosting archer accuracy to 100% and speeding up their rate of fire.
codex.bloodlinesBody: {count} of the {total} civilizations research {name} (+20 HP to all cavalry). Knowing who lacks it shapes whether Scouts or Knights pay off.
codex.hcBody: {count} of the {total} civilizations train {name} in Imperial — with zero prior upgrades needed, it shreds massed infantry immediately.
codex.halbBody: While {count} of {total} civilizations get {name}, the {missing} stuck on Pikeman struggle far more to stop heavy cavalry in Imperial.
codex.blockPrintBody: {count} of the {total} civilizations get {name}, extending Monk conversion range to 12 tiles to punish siege from a safe distance.
